title: Half at market, half at the retest limit (estimate)
question: Can a split entry keep the runners the retest misses and still take the better fills?
verdict: Estimate only: 2026 $13,845 (locked $20,487), 2021-25 $20,937 (locked $16,379). Needs an engine option before it can be judged.
notes: Not an engine replay: per day 0.5 x locked trade + 0.5 x retest trade (same direction). Ignores the interaction of two legs with the 1-trade-a-day rule, the cold-streak filter and breakeven moves.
sizing: estimate: average of the locked run and exec_retest per day; unfilled retest half = no trade
method: exact live-loop replay (20-day window per session) + cold-streak filter + sizing; costs included
